16. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The test report is for the P&T + Lube test of the 755 Front Agri Axle with reduced oil level (-0.5 lt.) and ELF SF3 oil.
17. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The test measures power loss, temperature raise, and lubrication performance.
18. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The test results show that the axle partially passed the test, with significantly lower power loss values compared to reference tests.
19. [ASSISTANT_SAID] There were issues with the P&T test as the temperature curves became irregular after 1h:6', with no stabilization, and power loss step-up.
20. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The lubrication test showed no signs of lubrication problems, and the oil level was always above the minimum oil level in all compartments.
21. [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is advised not to further reduce the oil level unless the power loss step-up issue is solved.
